title: 7 Things a Godly Brother Does That a Group Chat Never Will
caption:
7 things a godly brother does that a group chat never will.

None of them fit in a text.

1. Calls you out mid-sentence, not after you've already sinned.
2. Knows your specific sin, not just "keep me in your prayers."
3. Shows up at your door before you've asked him to.
4. Tells you the truth even when it costs the friendship.
5. Remembers what you confessed last month and asks about it (James 5:16).
6. Prays with you, not just for you from a distance.
7. Never lets your sin become a punchline.

A group chat can like your post. It can't do any of this.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #accountability #community
